body.name: One-unseen-row compatible RSCM class
body.construction: \(Mone=\{M: M\text{ is a finite RSCM over }S\text{ and }G;\ M\text{ induces the source groundings }Rsrc\text{ and target grounding }rho\text{ encoded by }Ictx,\text{ has independent ground noises and type-shared mechanisms, reproduces }Psrc,\text{ uses the rows }K\text{ recovered from positive-probability source parent contexts, and has exactly one unrestricted target-relevant binary row at }rstar\}\).
